svg.aria-label: The sewer pipe inspection image as a dense-detection primitive. Left: three capture modes — a forward-looking CCTV crawler video, the most common; a pan-tilt-zoom or side-scanning camera that unrolls the pipe wall; and 3D sensing with LiDAR, laser profilers or time-of-flight cameras that measure deformation. Right: a ladder of six output layers, from L0 position along the pipe in metres from the manhole, L1 frame normal versus defect, L2 multi-label defect classes per frame, L3 boxes or masks per defect, L4 standard code and severity grade such as PACP or EN 13508-2, to L5 a structural and operational condition score and a rehabilitation decision.
svg.title: The sewer inspection image: three capture modes, six output layers
svg.text: The sewer inspection image: three capture modes, six output layers
A dark, wet, curved tube seen by a moving robot. The utility needs a coded, graded defect log per pipe segment.
Capture mode decides what is measurable

g.text: Forward CCTV video · crawler robot
Hours of footage; defects appear for seconds.
Sees: cracks, roots, deposits, joints, intrusions.
Perspective, glare, water line, fog, lens dirt.
Sewer-ML (1.3M frames, 17 cls) · QV-Pipe · CCTV-Pipe
Pan-tilt-zoom / side-scan · unrolled wall
Operator stops and zooms, or a fisheye unrolls
the full wall into a flat strip image.
Enables pixel masks and crack length.
CSDD culvert-sewer (12,230 masks, 580 videos)
3D · LiDAR, laser ring, time-of-flight
Point clouds of the pipe bore.
Sees: ovality, deformation, displaced joints,
deposit volume — things RGB can only guess.
AAU sewer point clouds · synthetic → real gap

svg.text: Output layers (what a utility actually files)

g.text: L5 · condition score → rehab decision
structural + O&M grade per segment; reline, repair, clean
L4 · standard code + severity
PACP (N. America) · EN 13508-2 (EU) · WRc MSCC (UK)
L3 · box or mask per defect
YOLO / RT-DETR boxes; FORTRESS, RAPID-SCAN masks
L2 · multi-label classes per frame
L1 · frame normal vs defect · time interval
two-stage screeners; PipeSPO interval localisation
L0 · where: metres from manhole, clock position
OCR of on-screen distance; visual odometry; pipe ID

svg.text: Most public benchmarks score only L2 (frame-level multi-label) — labels come from inspector logs, not boxes, and are noisy.
The decision lives at L4–L5, where a misgraded root intrusion or deformation changes the rehabilitation plan.
